client.name: Government Real Estate Regulator
description: The client is the central regulatory body for the real estate sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Established in 2017, it regulates, oversees and develops non-governmental real estate activity. Its mandate covers market transparency, licensing, consumer protection, and supporting investment and governance across the industry, as part of the Kingdom's wider economic development and Vision 2030 goals. Folio3 partnered with the regulator to run an enterprise Power Automate RPA program that automates back-office work across seven business areas.

customer.heading: The Customer
paragraphs: Teams across the regulator's Shared Services, Operations, Strategic Communication and CEO Office were spending a large share of every week on manual, repetitive back-office work. These processes were slow, error-prone and dependent on individual employees, which left less capacity for higher-value regulatory and strategic work and made a strong case for RPA for government back-office operations.
The impact showed up in five places:
bullets: Staff re-keyed data by hand between Excel, Word, PDFs and government platforms such as Etimad, Murasalat, Kawader and Qimah.
Recurring daily, weekly and quarterly reports were downloaded, compiled and emailed manually.
HR teams handled a high volume of payroll, promotion, contract, attendance and employee notification transactions by hand.
Property listings on real estate portals were validated manually against the regulator's licence data.
Tasks were tracked across separate departmental plans, with no consolidated view for leadership.

needs.heading: What The Regulator Needed
needs.intro: The regulator needed an automation program that could:

items.text: Assess and prioritize back-office processes across departments in one shared list
Automate work on government and internal platforms that require UI-based interaction
Connect Microsoft 365 apps so recurring reports and notifications run without manual effort
Strengthen market oversight by checking property listings against licence data at scale
Give leadership a single, consolidated view of departmental plans

solution.heading: Folio3 Solution
solution.intro: Folio3 set up, and continues to run, an enterprise automation program on Microsoft Power Automate. Power Automate Desktop (RPA) handles UI-based platforms, while Power Automate cloud flows handle Microsoft 365 and system integrations. Every process is captured in a shared priority list and delivered through a structured lifecycle: discovery with the process owner, build, UAT, and handover on the user's own device or VM.

recognition.heading: Client Recognition
items: At the program's first major milestone, the team had delivered 40+ Power Automate use cases, creating approximately 350+ hours of saved effort. The regulator formally acknowledged and appreciated this value.
On the strength of those results, the engagement grew and Folio3 expanded the dedicated automation team.
The program has nearly doubled since that milestone, to 75 use cases in production and 650+ hours saved, with new use cases going live every month in support of Vision 2030 digital-government goals.
